articles.title: RACE 高中英语阅读 high24159
articles.source: RACE 中国高中英语考试阅读题库
articles.body:
On Web sites across the Internet, people can access a variety of information about you. It's in your interest to be aware of your online reputation and to take the necessary actions to make it what you want it to be.
   The first step in protecting or improving your online reputation is to find out what information is already posted on the Internet and to assess the impression it leaves on people. Follow these tips to monitor and evaluate your online reputation:
   Play the name game. Begin by typing your first and last name into several popular search engines to see where you are mentioned and in what context.
   Example:
   Robin Counts
   Focus your search. To get moreprecise  results, put quotation marks around your name, so that the search engine reads your name as a phrase and not as two or more unrelated words that just happen to appear in the text.
   Example:
"Robin Counts"
   Search all of your names. If you have ever used a different name, if you use your middle name or initial, if you use a nickname, or if your name is frequently misspelled, search all variations to make sure you don't miss anything important.
   Example:
   "Robin Counts"
   "Robin J. Counts"
   "Robin Counts Jensen"
   Be strategic. If your search turns up information about other people who share your name, you caneliminate  many false hits by using keywords. You can add keywords that apply only to you; for example your city, your employer, or a hobby.
   Example:
   "Robin Counts" "Woodgrove Bank"
   "Robin counts"----skydiving
   Go blogging. If any of your friends, family members or coworkers have blogs or personal Web pages on social networking sites, check them out from time to time to see if they are writing about you or posting pictures of you.
   Be alert. Use the feature provided by some search engines that enables you to receive automatic notification   of any new mention of your name or other personal information.

sentenceTranslations.On Web sites across the Internet, people: 在互联网的各种网站上，人们可以获取到关于你的各种信息。
sentenceTranslations.It's in your interest to be aware of you: 了解自己的网络声誉，并采取必要行动使其符合你的期望，这对你是有利的。
sentenceTranslations.The first step in protecting or improvin: 保护或提升网络声誉的第一步是查明互联网上已经发布了哪些关于你的信息，并评估这些信息给人留下的印象。
sentenceTranslations.Follow these tips to monitor and evaluat: 遵循以下建议来监测和评估你的网络声誉：玩转姓名搜索。
sentenceTranslations.Begin by typing your first and last name: 首先在几个主流搜索引擎中输入你的全名，查看你在哪些地方被提及以及提及的背景。
sentenceTranslations.Example: Robin Counts Focus your s: 示例：Robin Counts（请替换为你的姓名），聚焦搜索。
sentenceTranslations.To get moreprecise results, put quotati: 为了得到更精确的结果，请给你的名字加上引号，这样搜索引擎就会把你的名字作为一个短语来读取，而不是当成两个或多个恰好出现在文本中的无关单词。
sentenceTranslations.Example: \"Robin Counts\" Search all: 例如：“Robin Counts” 搜索你所有用过的名字。
sentenceTranslations.If you have ever used a different name,: 如果你曾用过不同的名字，如果你使用中间名或首字母，如果你使用昵称，或者如果你的名字经常被拼错，请搜索所有变体，以确保不会错过任何重要信息。
sentenceTranslations.Counts\" \"Robin Counts Jensen\" B: Counts”  “Robin Counts Jensen”  要有策略地搜索。
sentenceTranslations.If your search turns up information abou: 如果你的搜索显示出与你同名的其他人的信息，你可以通过使用关键词来排除许多错误的搜索结果。
sentenceTranslations.You can add keywords that apply only to: 你可以添加只适用于你的关键词；例如你的城市、你的雇主或爱好。
sentenceTranslations.Example: \"Robin Counts\" \"Woodgrove: 例如：    "Robin Counts" "Woodgrove Bank"    "Robin counts"----跳伞    写博客。
sentenceTranslations.If any of your friends, family members o: 如果你的任何朋友、家人或同事在社交网站上有博客或个人网页，不妨时不时去查看一下，看看他们是否在写关于你的内容或发布你的照片。
sentenceTranslations.Use the feature provided by some search: 使用某些搜索引擎提供的功能，它可以让你在有人新提及你的名字或其他个人信息时自动收到通知。

questions.prompt: The passage mainly gives us advice on   _  .
options: how to google ourselves
how to monitor our online reputation
how to use different search engines
how to protect our online reputation
questions.explanation: 文章开头指出要意识到自己的网络声誉，并采取行动，接着围绕“监控和评估在线声誉”给出了具体建议，所以主要是关于如何监控在线声誉。

questions.prompt: If you put quotation marks around your name when you search online, you will   _  .
options: get general information about yourself
still get other people's information
get only your information
get most information about others
questions.explanation: 用引号括起姓名会让搜索引擎将其视为一个完整短语，但若有人与你同名，他们的信息仍会出现，所以依然可能得到他人的信息。

questions.prompt: Which is the correct way to search if you want to eliminate many false hits?
options: "Jim Allan Green "
Jim Green
"Jim Green"
"Jim Green"---gardening.
questions.explanation: 根据“Be strategic”部分，要消除很多错误结果，需在姓名外添加与你相关的关键词，如园艺，“"Jim Green"---gardening”正符合这一模式。

questions.prompt: You are advised to go blogging to   _  .
options: have a better communication with your friends and family members
check out how popular you are with your friends and  s
check out if others are writing about you or posting pictures of you
ask others not to disclose your personal information and picture
questions.explanation: “Go blogging”部分明确建议查看朋友等的博客，目的是看他们是否写了关于你的事或发布了你的照片。

questions.prompt: The feature provided by some search engines can help you to
options: prevent any new mention of your name or other personal information
find out any new mention of your name or other personal information.
know quickly any new mention of your name or other personal information
stop the spread of any new mention of your name or other personal information
questions.explanation: “Be alert”部分提到某些搜索引擎的功能可以让你自动收到任何提及你名字或个人信息的通知，即帮助你快速知晓新的提及。
